text: Java is a general-purpose programming language. Java was originally developed at Sun Microsystems. Java programs run on the Java Virtual Machine. The Java Virtual Machine allows Java bytecode to run on different operating systems. Java is commonly used for backend development, enterprise applications, and Android development.

Python is a high-level programming language. Python was created by Guido van Rossum. Python emphasizes code readability and simplicity. Python is widely used for web development, data analysis, automation, and machine learning.

RAG stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. RAG allows an LLM to retrieve relevant information from external documents before generating an answer. RAG combines information retrieval with language generation. A RAG system first searches a collection of documents for relevant information and then provides that information to an LLM as context.
RAG can help an LLM answer questions using information that was not included in its original training data.
